requirements.title: Add InAppNotification Prisma model
requirements.description: Add an `InAppNotification` model to `prisma/schema.prisma` with fields: `id` (UUID primary key), `userId` (String, FK to User), `triggerType` (String enum: stall | deadline | daily_checkin | streak | milestone), `message` (String), `taskId` (optional String), `deliveredAt` (DateTime, default now()), `readAt` (optional DateTime), `createdAt` (DateTime, default now()). Table mapped to `in_app_notifications`. Composite index on `[userId, readAt]` for efficient unread queries. All column names use snake_case via `@map`.
acceptance_criteria: InAppNotification model exists in prisma/schema.prisma with all specified fields and types
Table is mapped to `in_app_notifications` via @@map
Composite index @@index([userId, readAt]) is present
All DateTime fields use snake_case @map aliases (delivered_at, read_at, created_at)
id field uses @default(uuid())

requirements.title: Add User-Notification relation
requirements.description: Add `notifications InAppNotification[]` relation to the existing `User` model in `prisma/schema.prisma`. The `InAppNotification.user` field references this via `@relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)`.

requirements.title: isInQuietHours checks user quiet hours window
requirements.description: The `isInQuietHours(userId)` method reads the user's `communicationPreferences.quietHours` from `User.preferences`. It determines if the current time (in the user's timezone from `preferences.timezone`) falls within the quiet hours window. Handles cross-midnight ranges (e.g., 22:00-08:00) where start > end means the range spans midnight.

requirements.title: Quiet hours defer notification delivery

Daily check-in and streak notifications during quiet hours should be skipped entirely (not deferred) since they are time-sensitive.
